# netskopebwan_controller (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netskopebwan_controller" "example" {
  operator_nrn = "<operator_nrn>"
  public_ipv4  = "<public_ipv4>"
  version      = "<version>"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `operator_nrn` (String) Operator NRN
- `public_ipv4` (String) Public IPv4
- `version` (String) Version of the controller

### Optional

- `provision` (Boolean) Indicates if the controller is provisioned
- `replicas` (Number) Number of replicas for the controller
- `resource_request` (Attributes) Resource request for the controller (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resource_request))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `created_by` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--created_by))
- `generation` (Number) Generation
- `id` (String) Controller ID
- `modified_at` (String)
- `modified_by` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--modified_by))
- `overlay_id` (Number) Overlay ID
- `overlay_ip` (String) Overlay IP
- `overlay_pubkey` (String) Overlay public key

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netskopebwan_controller.example <id>
```
